text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I want to show hope to those striving to 
rise again as soon as possible. To do 
that,
I must deliver a great result in the 
year-end grand stage, the Tokyo Daishoten.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Adjusting Wonder Acute during her Classic 
year was harsh, but she made it just in 
time, miraculously.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The opponent is Smart Falcon,
queen of the dirt.
Against a strictly superior foe with 
the crowd completely on her side,
how well will she be able to hold her own?
